question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Petite
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"petite"** means small in size or having a small and attractively dainty build. (छोटा)

 
 
• **Example: **She wore a beautiful petite dress for the evening party.
 
 
 
• **"Small" **refers to something that is little in size, quantity, or extent. (छोटा)
 
 
• **Example: **The small puppy fit perfectly in her hands.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'petite' **is **'small'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Best **(सबसे अच्छा): Of the highest quality, excellence, or standing.

 
 
• **Example:** She is the best student in the class.
 
 
 
• **Flexible **(लचीला): Capable of bending easily without breaking.
 
 
• **Example: **The flexible hose can be adjusted to any direction.
 
 
 
• **Fit** (फिट): In good health, especially because of regular physical exercise.
 
 
• **Example:** He goes to the gym daily to stay fit.
